decision.explanation: The sources provide three distinct performance start dates for the 'Freaky Friday' musical at different venues: October 4, 2016 (Signature Theatre, Arlington, Virginia) per D1S1; January 31, 2017 (La Jolla Playhouse, San Diego) per D1S5 and D2S5; and January 1, 2018 (Signature Theatre, Arlington, Virginia) per D2S1. All three dates represent valid instances of the musical beginning performances at specific locations, satisfying the request for a complete set of answers without collapsing distinct events.
